==Description==
The '''Overgrowth''' was the second enemy that appeared in the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had higher health but was slower than the [[Pumpkid]].

==Appearance==
The '''Overgrowth''' was a living, humanoid made out of wood. It had vines growing all over its body, as well as dark brown bark patches on its torso and right arm. Its left leg was carved in around what would be the knee area. It had yellow eyes and the top of its head was splintered.

==Strategy==
*Cheap and high DPS towers like the [[Crook Boss]]/[[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Ace Pilot]], [[Golden Soldier]] and [[Golden Scout]] can kill it easily.
*Towers with the capability to damage chains of enemies at once, like the [[Executioner]] or the [[Pyromancer]], are extremely useful against this enemy.
